scientific_integrity: All mathematical equalities are supported by the included proof. Finite checker runs do not establish the unbounded theorem. No independent review or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Fully occupied labeled rings with n at least five, two binary types, uniform weak radius-two satisfaction threshold.
Counts fully satisfied configurations; does not characterize dynamically absorbing configurations, hitting probabilities, or empirical segregation.
Structural minimum-run sufficient conditions appear in earlier majority cellular-automaton research; only the exact population-resolved census and entropy are assessed as the new contribution.
Historical priority is provisional; equivalence with an unlocated counting table remains a residual risk.
title: Exact population-resolved census and entropy of fully satisfied radius-two Schelling rings
